title: Just start typing
text: Adding a book used to mean typing everything. Now Nia starts typing a title, and matching books drop down under it, each with its cover.

title: Pick a match
text: She picks The Hobbit. The author and the cover fill in by themselves, and she only has to say how many chapters it has.

title: Guesses are labelled
text: When the catalogue has nothing, Shelfie offers guesses instead. Each one is marked Suggested, with a reminder to check it before adding the book.

title: Never in the way
text: If the lookup ever fails, a short note says so, and Nia can carry on typing the book in herself.
